title: Unified mobile footer navigation
summary: Refined navigation into one divided panel with inset expanded links and clearer legal text.

changes.detail: Replaced separate outlined accordion boxes with a single rounded panel, thin dividers, 15px headings and subtler chevrons. Expanded links sit in a soft tinted inset.
Increased copyright text to 12px with balanced wrapping and arranged legal links into two columns with 44px tap targets.
Explicit dark mobile legal-link hover and active colors prevent desktop light text styles from reducing contrast.
